# hpe_morpheus_certificate (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_certificate" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_certificate" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the certificate.
- `name` (String) The name of the certificate.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (Number) The account ID associated with the certificate.
- `category` (String) The category of the certificate.
- `cert_type` (String) The certificate type (e.g. server, authority).
- `common_name` (String) The common name (CN) of the certificate.
- `description` (String) A description of the certificate.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain name this certificate is tied to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is enabled.
- `generated` (Boolean) Whether the certificate was generated by Morpheus.
- `integration_id` (Number) The integration ID associated with the certificate.
- `self_signed` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is self-signed.
- `type` (Attributes) The certificate type reference object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--type))
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is a wildcard certificate.

<a id="nestedatt--type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `type`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) The certificate type object code.
- `id` (Number) The certificate type object ID.
